angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 669,959 km at 186.42 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3641 +/- 0.0186 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94): 186.42 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.963 +/- 0.027 solar radii from Smith et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-104 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract): 669,959 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.076 +/- 0.049 solar masses from Smith et al. 2014, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-104 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5475 +/- 127 K from Smith et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-104 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Smith et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-104 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-104.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.503, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-104 (pscomppars): spectral type G8, from Smith et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-104 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.32 dex, from Smith et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-104 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.18964, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-104 (pscomppars): age 3 Gyr, from Smith et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-104 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.4 km/s, from Smith et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...570A..64S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
